functional.statement: The system shall list the missing fields when an organizer submits a request without a title, date, venue, attendees or budget.
acceptance: Given a request without a venue, when the organizer submits it, then the system lists venue as missing and creates no request.
Given a complete request, when the organizer submits it, then the system accepts it and gives it a request number.

functional.statement: The system shall mark the date check as failed when the event date is a public holiday in the Philippines.
acceptance: Given the date 2027-12-25 is Christmas Day, when the date check runs, then the check fails and names the holiday.
Given the date 2027-03-04 is not a holiday, when the date check runs, then the check passes.

functional.statement: The system shall mark the venue check as failed when the venue is reserved on the date or holds fewer people than the attendees.
acceptance: Given Room 101 holds 60 people, when a request has 80 attendees, then the venue check fails with the reason capacity.
Given the Gym is free on 2027-03-04, when a request has 120 attendees, then the venue check passes.

functional.statement: The system shall mark the venue check as failed when the venue has an unpaid facility penalty.
acceptance: Given Room 101 has an unpaid penalty of 50 pesos, when a request asks for Room 101, then the venue check fails with the reason penalty.
Given the Gym has no penalty, when a request asks for the Gym, then the penalty does not fail the check.

functional.statement: The system shall mark the weather check as failed when an outdoor event has a rain chance of 60 percent or more on its date.
acceptance: Given an outdoor event and a rain chance of 70 percent, when the weather check runs, then the check fails.
Given an indoor event, when the weather check runs, then the check is skipped and passes.

functional.statement: The system shall mark the budget check as failed when the deposit of the request is not fully paid.
acceptance: Given request EVT-0004 has a balance of 320 pesos, when the budget check runs, then the check fails.
Given request EVT-0001 has a balance of 0, when the budget check runs, then the deposit does not fail the check.

functional.statement: The system shall convert a budget in another currency to Philippine pesos at the latest exchange rate.
acceptance: Given a budget of 500 USD and a rate of 63.46, when the budget check runs, then the budget is 31730 pesos.
Given a budget of 15000 PHP, when the budget check runs, then the budget stays 15000 pesos.

functional.statement: The system shall approve a request only when the holiday, venue, weather and budget checks all passed.
acceptance: Given all four checks passed, when the decision is made, then the decision is approved.
Given the venue check failed and three checks passed, when the decision is made, then the decision is returned.

functional.statement: The system shall set the status of a request to Approved when the officer approves it.
acceptance: Given a pending request whose checks all passed, when the officer approves it, then its status is Approved.
Given a request that is already Approved, when the officer opens it, then the approve action is not offered.

functional.statement: The system shall return a request to the organizer with the reason of every failed check.
acceptance: Given a request that failed the date check and the venue check, when the officer returns it, then the status is Returned and both reasons are listed.
Given a request with no failed check, when the officer returns it, then the system asks for a written reason.

functional.statement: The system shall send the organizer a notice with the decision and its reasons.
acceptance: Given a returned request with the reason holiday, when the decision is made, then the organizer receives a notice that names the holiday.
Given the e-mail cannot be sent, when the notice is sent, then the system tries again later and records the failure.

functional.statement: The system shall mark a request as needs-review when an outside service does not answer and no other check failed.
acceptance: Given the holiday service is down and the other checks passed, when the decision is made, then the decision is needs-review with the reason holiday service.
Given the weather service is down and the venue check failed, when the decision is made, then the decision is returned.
